article_framing_rejections.headline: Hallandale Beach man arrested in Vero Beach after traveling to meet 14-year-old

lead_independence.headline: Hallandale Beach man arrested in Vero Beach after traveling to meet 14-year-old
lead_independence.lead: Emaad Mir, 27, of Hallandale Beach, was arrested on Aug. 8 after he allegedly traveled to Indian River County to meet a 14-year-old, according to Indian River County Sheriff's Office reports. Mir was communicating with undercover detectives working alongside the juvenile's parents for some time, with Mir believing that the person was 14. He is in the Indian River County Jail on charges of traveling to meet after use of a computer to lure a child, transmit information harmful to minors, and unlawful use of a two-way communications device.
